title: WP0.7 — Lock publication projection, bundle access, withdrawal, and privacy
description:
## Decision

Owned by cli/ and platform/. v0.2 inherits the shipped publication write protocol and adds a techtree.published-result.v1 read projection at GET /api/v1/publications/:bundle_digest plus exact stored submission download at GET /api/v1/publications/:bundle_digest/bundle. Withdrawal preserves the tombstone, receipt, and metadata but removes discovery and disables bundle download with 410 Gone. Billing labels remain private by default. ash-regents is required for platform work.

## Rationale

Extending the shipped publication resource preserves one receipt and withdrawal protocol while making public evidence machine-readable and exactly downloadable.

## Alternatives Considered

A new /api/v1/results resource, re-encoding stored bundles, public billing labels by default, and deleting withdrawn metadata or receipts are rejected.
acceptance_criteria: PUBLICATION_WITHDRAWAL_AUDIT.md identifies the inherited write bytes and exact WP5 additions; no /api/v1/results route or second proof system exists; active bundle download returns exact stored submission bytes without re-encoding; withdrawn download returns 410 while metadata and tombstone remain; private evidence and billing labels are omitted by default; WP0 implements no facet persistence or browser controller.

title: WP0.6 — Lock the CLI v2 machine contract and plugin map
description:
## Decision

Owned by cli/ and plugin/. Freeze techtree.cli.v2 as the sole v0.2 machine envelope, with no v1 adapter or dual mode. Define the exact typed next_actions, stable operation identifiers mapped to existing CLI handlers, bounded run.wait, five-state public projection over detailed append-only phases, and the plugin/hermes plus plugin/codex packaging map. Frozen v0.1 packages keep their historical v1 bytes.

## Rationale

One direct contract avoids split behavior while preserving historical release evidence. Existing handlers remain the command authority; operation identifiers describe them rather than duplicate them.

## Alternatives Considered

A v1 adapter, dual mode, second CLI hierarchy, daemon, busy polling, shared plugin SDK, and plugin-owned execution state are rejected.
acceptance_criteria: MACHINE_CONTRACT.md and PLUGIN_LAYOUT.md define the complete v2 envelope, operation inventory, typed next actions, state projection, and bounded long-poll behavior; Hermes and Codex consumers migrate atomically; no v0.2 v1 projector, second CLI hierarchy, busy-polling, daemon, shared plugin SDK, or plugin-owned scheduler/receipt/approval/publication behavior is introduced.
